Class AuthenticatedUserRealm

java.lang.Object
org.apache.catalina.util.LifecycleBase
org.apache.catalina.util.LifecycleMBeanBase
org.apache.catalina.realm.RealmBase
org.apache.catalina.realm.AuthenticatedUserRealm
All Implemented Interfaces:
MBeanRegistration, Contained, JmxEnabled, Lifecycle, Realm
public class AuthenticatedUserRealm extends RealmBase
This Realm is intended for use with Authenticator implementations (SSLAuthenticator, SpnegoAuthenticator) that authenticate the user as well as obtain the user credentials. An authenticated Principal is always created from the username presented to without further validation.

Note: It is unsafe to use this Realm with Authenticator implementations that do not validate the provided credentials.
